BookId.description: IDs for books. Follows the USFM standard (https://ubsicap.github.io/usfm/identification/books.html)

translations.description: The list of translations that are available in the API.

ApiAvailableTranslations.description: The list of available translations. Maps to the /api/available-translations.json endpoint.

licenseUrl.description: The URL that the license for the translation can be found.

licenseNotes.description: The API-added notes for the license.

licenseNotice.description: The notice that should be displayed when displaying content from the translation.

license.description: The structured license terms that were detected for the translation, if any.

shortName.description: The short name for the translation.

englishName.description: The English name for the translation.

language.description: The ISO 639 3-letter language tag that the translation is primarily in.

textDirection.description: The direction that the language is written in. `ltr` indicates that the text is written from the left side of the page to the right. `rtl` indicates that the text is written from the right side of the page to the left.

listOfBooksApiLink.description: The API link for the list of books for this translation. Relative to the API origin.

numberOfBooks.description: The number of books that are contained in this translation. Complete translations should have the same number of books as the Bible (66).

totalNumberOfChapters.description: The total number of chapters that are contained in this translation. Complete translations should have the same number of chapters as the Bible (1,189).

totalNumberOfVerses.description: The total number of verses that are contained in this translation. Complete translations should have the same number of verses as the Bible (around 31,102 - some translations exclude verses based on the aparent likelyhood of existing in the original source texts).

numberOfApocryphalBooks.description: The total number of apocryphal books that are contained in this translation.

totalNumberOfApocryphalChapters.description: The total number of apocryphal chapters that are contained in this translation.

totalNumberOfApocryphalVerses.description: The total number of apocryphal verses that are contained in this translation.

languageName.description: Gets the name of the language that the translation is in. Null or undefined if the name of the language is not known.

languageEnglishName.description: Gets the name of the language in English. Null or undefined if the language doesn't have an english name.

completeTranslationApiLink.description: The API link for downloading the complete translation as a single JSON file. Relative to the API origin. Undefined if complete translation files are not available.

simpleCompleteTranslationApiLink.description: The API link for downloading the complete translation as a single JSON file, using the simplified chapter format. Relative to the API origin. Undefined if complete translation files are not available.

ApiTranslation.description: Defines a translation that is used in the API.

attribution.description: Whether attribution to the original source is required when using the translation.

commercialUse.description: Whether commercial use of the translation is allowed.

derivatives.description: Whether creating and distributing derivative works of the translation is allowed.

copyleft.description: Whether derivative works must be distributed under the same license (i.e. a "share-alike" requirement).

publicDomain.description: Whether the translation has been dedicated to the public domain.

License.description: Defines the structured license terms that were detected for a translation.

translation.description: The translation information for the books.

books.description: The list of books that are available for the translation.

ApiTranslationBooks.description: Defines an interface that contains information about the books that are available for a translation.

name.description: The name that the translation provided for the book.

commonName.description: The common name for the book.

title.description: The title of the book. This is usually a more descriptive version of the book name. If not available, then one was not provided by the translation.

order.description: The numerical order of the book in the translation.

isApocryphal.description: Whether the book is an apocryphal book.

firstChapterNumber.description: The number of the first chapter in the book.

firstChapterApiLink.description: The link to the first chapter of the book.

lastChapterNumber.description: The number of the last chapter in the book.

lastChapterApiLink.description: The link to the last chapter of the book.

numberOfChapters.description: The number of chapters that the book contains.

totalNumberOfVerses.description: The number of verses that the book contains.

ApiTranslationBook.description: Defines a schema that contains information about a translation book.

translationId.description: The ID of the translation that the chapter reference is for.

chapter.description: The chapter number of the chapter reference.

TranslationChapterReference.description: Defines a reference to a chapter in a translation.

footnotes.description: The list of footnotes for the chapter.

thisChapterAudioLinks.description: The links to different audio versions for the chapter.

thisChapterAudioTimings.description: The links to the audio timings for different audio versions for the chapter. Relative to the API origin.

translation.description: The translation information for the book chapter.

book.description: The book information for the book chapter.

thisChapterLink.description: The API link for this chapter. Relative to the API origin.

nextChapterApiLink.description: The API link to the next chapter. Relative to the API origin. Null if this is the last chapter in the translation.

nextChapterReference.description: The reference for the next chapter. Null if this is the last chapter in the translation.

nextChapterAudioLinks.description: The links to the audio versions for the next chapter. Relative to the API origin. Null if this is the last chapter in the translation.

nextChapterAudioTimings.description: The links to the audio timings for different audio versions for the next chapter. Relative to the API origin. Null if this is the last chapter in the translation.

previousChapterAudioTimings.description: The links to the audio timings for different audio versions for the previous chapter. Relative to the API origin. Null if this is the first chapter in the translation.

previousChapterApiLink.description: The API link to the previous chapter. Relative to the API origin. Null if this is the first chapter in the translation.

previousChapterReference.description: The reference for the previous chapter. Null if this is the first chapter in the translation.

previousChapterAudioLinks.description: The links to the audio versions for the previous chapter. Relative to the API origin. Null if this is the first chapter in the translation.

thisChapterWordsLink.description: The link to the word-level annotations for this chapter. Relative to the API origin. Omitted if the chapter doesn't have any word-level annotations.

nextChapterWordsLink.description: The link to the word-level annotations for the next chapter. Relative to the API origin. Omitted if this is the last chapter in the translation, or if the next chapter doesn't have any word-level annotations.

previousChapterWordsLink.description: The link to the word-level annotations for the previous chapter. Relative to the API origin. Omitted if this is the first chapter in the translation, or if the previous chapter doesn't have any word-level annotations.

numberOfVerses.description: The number of verses that the chapter contains.

simpleChapterApiLink.description: The API link to the simplified version of this chapter. Relative to the API origin. Omitted if simplified chapters are not available.

ApiTranslationBookChapter.description: Defines an interface that contains information about a book chapter in a translation.

ChapterContent.description: Defines a union type that represents a single piece of chapter content. A piece of chapter content can be one of the following things: A heading, a line break, a verse, or a Hebrew Subtitle.

content.description: The content for the heading. If multiple strings are included in the array, they should be concatenated with a space.

ChapterHeading.description: Defines the schema for a heading in a chapter.

ChapterLineBreak.description: Defines the schema for a line break in a chapter.

content.description: The list of content for the verse. Each element in the list could be a string, formatted text, or a footnote reference.

ChapterVerse.description: Defines the schema for a verse in a chapter.

poem.description: Whether the text represents a poem. The number indicates the level of indent. Common in Psalms.

wordsOfJesus.description: Whether the text represents the Words of Jesus.

FormattedText.description: Defines the schema for formatted text. That is, text that is formatted in a particular manner.

InlineHeading.description: Defines the schema for a heading that is embedded in a verse.

InlineLineBreak.description: Defines the schema for a line break that is embedded in a verse.

VerseFootnoteReference.description: Defines the schema for a footnote reference in a verse or a Hebrew Subtitle.

content.description: The content that is contained in the subtitle. Each element in the list could be a string, formatted text, or a footnote reference.

ChapterHebrewSubtitle.description: Defines the schema for a Hebrew Subtitle in a chapter.

noteId.description: The ID of the note that is referenced.

reference.description: The verse reference for the footnote. Undefined if the footnote isn't associated with a specific verse.

caller.description: The caller that should be used for the footnote. For footnotes, a "caller" is the character that is used in the text to reference to footnote. For example, in the text: Hello (a) World ---- (a) This is a footnote. The "(a)" is the caller. If "+", then the caller should be autogenerated. If null, then the caller should be empty. If a string, then the caller should be that string.

ChapterFootnote.description: Defines the schema for information about a footnote.

TranslationBookChapterAudioLinks.description: Defines the schema for the audio links for a book chapter.

thisChapterAudioLinks.description: The links to different audio versions for the chapter.

thisChapterAudioTimings.description: The links to the audio timings for different audio versions for the chapter. Relative to the API origin.

translation.description: The translation information for the book chapter.

book.description: The book information for the book chapter.

thisChapterLink.description: The API link for this chapter. Relative to the API origin.

nextChapterApiLink.description: The API link to the next chapter. Relative to the API origin. Null if this is the last chapter in the translation.

nextChapterReference.description: The reference for the next chapter. Null if this is the last chapter in the translation.

nextChapterAudioLinks.description: The links to the audio versions for the next chapter. Relative to the API origin. Null if this is the last chapter in the translation.

nextChapterAudioTimings.description: The links to the audio timings for different audio versions for the next chapter. Relative to the API origin. Null if this is the last chapter in the translation.

previousChapterAudioTimings.description: The links to the audio timings for different audio versions for the previous chapter. Relative to the API origin. Null if this is the first chapter in the translation.

previousChapterApiLink.description: The API link to the previous chapter. Relative to the API origin. Null if this is the first chapter in the translation.

previousChapterReference.description: The reference for the previous chapter. Null if this is the first chapter in the translation.

previousChapterAudioLinks.description: The links to the audio versions for the previous chapter. Relative to the API origin. Null if this is the first chapter in the translation.

thisChapterWordsLink.description: The link to the word-level annotations for this chapter. Relative to the API origin. Omitted if the chapter doesn't have any word-level annotations.

nextChapterWordsLink.description: The link to the word-level annotations for the next chapter. Relative to the API origin. Omitted if this is the last chapter in the translation, or if the next chapter doesn't have any word-level annotations.

previousChapterWordsLink.description: The link to the word-level annotations for the previous chapter. Relative to the API origin. Omitted if this is the first chapter in the translation, or if the previous chapter doesn't have any word-level annotations.

numberOfVerses.description: The number of verses that the chapter contains.

chapter.description: The simplified information for the chapter. Each verse contains a single text string, and the footnotes and formatting are represented by offsets into that string.

fullChapterApiLink.description: The API link to the regular (non-simplified) version of this chapter. Relative to the API origin.

ApiSimpleTranslationBookChapter.description: Defines an interface that contains information about a book chapter in a translation, using the simplified chapter format.

footnotes.description: The list of footnotes that could not be associated with a verse. Footnotes that belong to a verse are included on the verse itself, so this list is usually empty.

SimpleChapterData.description: Defines the schema for the data in a simplified chapter. Unlike the regular chapter format, each verse contains a single text string and the footnotes/formatting are represented by offsets into that string.

SimpleChapterContent.description: Defines a union type that represents a single piece of content in a simplified chapter. A piece of chapter content can be one of the following things: A heading, a line break, a verse, or a Hebrew Subtitle.

SimpleChapterHeading.description: Defines the schema for a heading in a simplified chapter.

text.description: The text of the verse. Lines of poetry and line breaks are separated by newline (\n) characters.

footnotes.description: The footnotes that occur in the verse.

headings.description: The headings that occur in the middle of the verse. Omitted if the verse contains no inline headings.

wordsOfJesus.description: The ranges of the verse text that represent the Words of Jesus. Omitted if the verse contains none.

poem.description: The ranges of the verse text that represent lines of poetry. Omitted if the verse contains none.

SimpleChapterVerse.description: Defines the schema for a verse in a simplified chapter.

offset.description: The index in the verse text that the footnote caller should be inserted at. Measured in UTF-16 code units.

caller.description: The caller that should be used for the footnote. If "+", then the caller should be autogenerated. If null, then the caller should be empty. If a string, then the caller should be that string.

SimpleVerseFootnote.description: Defines the schema for a footnote in a simplified verse. Unlike the footnotes in the regular chapter format, simplified footnotes include the position that they occur at in the verse text.

offset.description: The index in the verse text that the heading occurs at. Measured in UTF-16 code units.

SimpleInlineHeading.description: Defines the schema for a heading that is embedded in a simplified verse.

start.description: The index of the first character of the range in the verse text. Measured in UTF-16 code units.

end.description: The index after the last character of the range in the verse text. Measured in UTF-16 code units.

SimpleTextRange.description: Defines the schema for a range of text inside a simplified verse. Ranges are expressed as offsets into the text of the verse that contains them, measured in UTF-16 code units.

start.description: The index of the first character of the range in the verse text. Measured in UTF-16 code units.

end.description: The index after the last character of the range in the verse text. Measured in UTF-16 code units.

level.description: The level of indent that the line of poetry should be displayed with.

SimplePoemRange.description: Defines the schema for a range of text inside a simplified verse that represents a line of poetry.

text.description: The text of the verse. Lines of poetry and line breaks are separated by newline (\n) characters.

footnotes.description: The footnotes that occur in the verse.

headings.description: The headings that occur in the middle of the verse. Omitted if the verse contains no inline headings.

wordsOfJesus.description: The ranges of the verse text that represent the Words of Jesus. Omitted if the verse contains none.

poem.description: The ranges of the verse text that represent lines of poetry. Omitted if the verse contains none.

SimpleChapterHebrewSubtitle.description: Defines the schema for a Hebrew Subtitle in a simplified chapter.

audioLink.description: The link to the audio for these timings.

thisChapterLink.description: The link to the information for this chapter.

nextChapterLink.description: The link to the information for the next chapter. Null if this is the last chapter in the translation.

previousChapterLink.description: The link to the information for the previous chapter. Null if this is the first chapter in the translation.

thisChapterAudioTimingsLink.description: The link to this audio timings file.

nextChapterAudioTimingsLink.description: The link to the timings for the next chapter. Null if this is the last chapter in the translation.

previousChapterAudioTimingsLink.description: The link to the timings for the previous chapter. Null if this is the first chapter in the translation.

verses.description: The times in seconds at which each verse starts, in order. The first number (index 0) is the time in the recording at which the first verse starts.

ApiTranslationBookChapterAudioTimings.description: Defines an interface that contains the audio timings for a book chapter, for a specific reader.

thisChapterLink.description: The link to the information for this chapter.
